methods_quotes.q: Descriptive analyses of the proportion and associated 95% CI
The Rao-Scott chi-square test was used to test differences in proportion of respondents that reported having used an at-home test
All chi-square tests were statistically significant at the Bonferroni corrected p-value threshold of 0.0024
Survey data were weighted for age, race/ethnicity
